summary: Greenfire Resources filed a 6-K reporting preliminary results of its C$775 million rights offering, which expired September 15, 2026 and closed September 16, 2026. The offering was oversubscribed with 113,685,671 shares subscribed under the basic privilege and 26,734,254 under the additional privilege, resulting in 114,985,163 common shares issued—the maximum available and without relying on the Waterous Energy Fund standby commitment. Proceeds will fully repay a C$575 million bridge facility and a portion of other debt from the Connacher Oil and Gas acquisition. The oversubscription and elimination of the standby backstop reduce overhang risk; watch final allocation and debt reduction confirmation.
